units.text: It opens TrueType (.ttf), CFF (.cff), EOT (.eot), OpenType (.otf), Type 1, WOFF, and WOFF2 fonts using FontLoader.open, and writes optimized web font packages with WebFontOptimizer.build and WebFontOptimizerPackage.write_to. It creates static instances from variable fonts using font.smart_instancer.instantiate, subsets fonts by text or script presets using FontSubsetter.subset_by_text, FontSubsetter.subset_by_presets, and FontSubsetter.subset_for_web, and generates QA reports using FontQaReporter.build_package. It renders visual specimens with FontPreviewBuilder.render_color_glyph, FontPreviewBuilder.render_svg_glyph_to_png, and FontPreviewBuilder.render_cbdt_glyph_to_png, and exports reports in JSON, HTML, Markdown, and PDF using FontQaReport.write_json, FontQaReport.write_html, FontQaReport.write_markdown, and FontQaReport.write_pdf.
It reads .cff, .eot, and .ttf font files using the aspose_font.FontLoader.open method and exposes them as Font objects that support multiple formats.

It creates static instances from variable fonts by accessing aspose_font.TtfFont.smart_instancer to obtain an aspose_font.SmartInstancer, then uses aspose_font.SmartInstancer.instantiate with named axis values and a naming strategy to produce a new font.

It builds a web font package for a font using aspose_font.WebFontOptimizer.build with presets, text, and variable mode options, then writes the package to disk using aspose_font.WebFontOptimizerPackage.write_to.

It subsets fonts by text or by preset coverage using aspose_font.FontSubsetter.subset_for_web or aspose_font.FontSubsetter.subset_by_presets, and provides aspose_font.FontSubsetter.available_presets to discover supported coverage sets.

It generates QA reports in JSON and HTML formats by calling aspose_font.FontQaReporter.build_package to obtain a package object containing paths to generated reports, then writes the report using aspose_font.FontQaReport.write_json and aspose_font.FontQaReport.write_html on the returned report object.

It renders SVG glyphs to PNG using aspose_font.FontPreviewBuilder.render_svg_glyph_to_png, and renders color and CBDT glyphs to PNG using aspose_font.FontPreviewBuilder.render_color_glyph and aspose_font.FontPreviewBuilder.render_cbdt_glyph_to_png (render_color_glyph requires a TTF font with color glyphs, and render_cbdt_glyph_to_png and render_svg_glyph_to_png require TTF fonts and raise FontNotSupportedException for other formats). It converts rasterized content to PNG using a Rasterizer instance method to_png or animated PNG using aspose_font.rasterizer.encode_apng_from_rgb.

Connect Aspose.Font directly to AI agents using the standard MCP protocol via aspose_font.mcp.main, supporting font conversion, subsetting, and web building through aspose_font.mcp.font_convert, aspose_font.mcp.font_subset, and aspose_font.mcp.web_build.
It provides a command-line interface through aspose_font.cli.main that wraps the core functionality for batch processing and automation.
This example opens a variable font, prints its axes, and creates a static instance with specific weight and width settings, then saves it as a new font file.
Create web font packages and generate QA reports for variable fonts.
Build a web font package with WOFF2, WOFF, and specimen HTML.
Generate a QA report with JSON, HTML, and visual proof outputs.

The aspose_font package provides core font processing capabilities through the FontLoader class for loading font files and the SmartInstancer class for instantiating variable font instances. The WebFontOptimizer, FontSubsetter, and FontQaReporter classes support web font optimization, subsetting, and quality assurance tasks respectively.
The aspose_font module serves as the top-level namespace for font processing operations in Aspose.Font FOSS for Python.
The FontLoader class provides the open method to load font files from disk.
The SmartInstancer class provides the instantiate method to create specific instances from variable fonts.
The WebFontOptimizer class provides the build_interactive_playground method to generate interactive web font previews.
The FontSubsetter class provides the subset_by_text method to create font subsets based on provided text content.
The FontQaReporter class provides the build_package method to generate quality assurance reports for font packages.
The cli module provides the main entry point for command-line operations in Aspose.Font FOSS for Python.
The mcp module provides the main entry point for Model Control Protocol server operations in Aspose.Font FOSS for Python.
It adds variable font instancing and subsetting capabilities not present in this package.
ActiveTupleSummary class provides a dictionary representation of active tuple data via the to_dict method.
AnimationAsset class supports writing its data via the write_to method.
AnimationFramePackage class supports writing its data via the write_to method.
AnimationPreset class represents a named animation preset.

AnimationPreviewBuilder class provides methods to build axis sweep, named instance path, export package, path, path package, path review package, and path showcase package, and raises ValueError in build_axis_sweep and build_named_instance_path.
AnimationReviewPackage class supports writing its data via the write_to method.
AnimationShowcasePackage class supports writing its data via the write_to method.
AnimationStep class represents a single step in an animation sequence.
AxisRecord class represents a single axis record in a font.
CffFont class, derived from Font, provides read-only properties for charset, charstrings, encoding, font_family, font_name, font_style, font_type, and methods for get_kern_pairs.
ClosePath class represents a path command that closes the current subpath.
CompatibilityChecker class provides methods to compare fonts and variable instances, and compare_variable_instances raises FontNotSupportedException.
CompatibilityReport class provides a read-only property is_compatible and methods to_dict, to_json, and write_json.
CompositeComponentMovement class represents movement information for a composite component.
CompositeGlyphComponent class represents a component of a composite glyph.
CurveTo class represents a cubic Bézier curve path command.

DeltaInspector class provides methods to build delta comparison sheets, delta sheets, delta text comparison sheets, delta text sheets, and to compare and inspect variable glyphs and text, and raises ValueError in build_delta_text_comparison_sheet, build_delta_text_sheet, and compare_variable_text.
DeltaPoint class provides a dictionary representation of delta point data via the to_dict method.
DeltaTupleReport class provides a dictionary representation of delta tuple data via the to_dict method.
FamilyReviewExportPackage class represents a package for exporting family review data.
Font class is the base class for font representations, and its to_bytes method raises NotImplementedError.
FontConversionException class represents an exception during font conversion.
FontEncoding class represents font encoding information.
FontException class is the base exception for font-related errors.
FontLoader class provides methods to load and open fonts, and load raises UnsupportedFontFormatException.
FontMetrics class represents font metrics data.
FontNotSupportedException class represents an exception when a font format is not supported.
FontParseException class represents an exception during font parsing.

FontPreviewBuilder class provides methods to build previews, compose difference and overlay previews, compose sheets, and render glyphs to PNG, and raises ValueError in compose_sheet and FontNotSupportedException in render_cbdt_glyph_to_png, render_color_glyph, render_sbix_glyph_to_png, and render_svg_glyph_to_png.
FontSubsetter class provides methods to analyze coverage, benchmark subsetting, and subset fonts, and benchmark_subsetting raises ValueError.
FontType enum lists the CFF, EOT, OTF, TTF, TYPE1, TYPE1_PFA, WOFF, and WOFF2 font type values.
FvarTable class provides methods to serialize its data to bytes via to_bytes.
Glyph class represents a single glyph in a font.
GlyphAccessor class provides access to glyphs in a font.
GlyphCompatibilityIssue class provides a dictionary representation of glyph compatibility issues via the to_dict method.
GlyphDeltaComparisonReport class provides read-only properties is_comparable and moved_point_count, and a to_dict method.
GlyphDeltaReport class provides a dictionary representation of glyph delta data via the to_dict method.
GlyphId class represents a unique identifier for a glyph.
GlyphInterpolationIssue class provides a dictionary representation of glyph interpolation issues via the to_dict method.
GlyphNotFoundException class represents an exception when a glyph is not found.
GlyphOutlineStats class provides a dictionary representation of glyph outline statistics via the to_dict method.
GlyphPath class represents a glyph path.
KernPair class represents a kerning pair.
LanguageProfile class provides a dictionary representation of language profile data via the to_dict method.
LineTo class represents a line-to path command.
LocalizationCoverage class exposes available_count, matched_count, missing_count, and requested_count read-only properties and provides a dictionary representation via the to_dict method.
LocalizationResolution class exposes an is_exact_match read-only property and provides a dictionary representation via the to_dict method.
MoveTo class represents a move-to path command.
NamedInstance class represents a named instance.
PathCommand class represents a path command.
PlatformNamingDiagnostics class provides a dictionary representation of platform naming diagnostics via the to_dict method.
PreviewImage class provides a write_to method to write preview image data.
QuadraticTo class represents a quadratic-to path command.
RequestedLanguageHint class exposes a has_requested_language_label read-only property and provides a dictionary representation via the to_dict method.
ResolvedInstance class exposes a label read-only property.

SmartInstancer class exposes an axes read-only property and provides methods such as build_axis_grid_previews, build_axis_grid_sheet, and build_axis_grid_web_bundles; its __init__, partial_instantiate, resolve, and resolve_axis_grid methods raise errors conditionally.
StatNamingDiagnostics class provides a dictionary representation of STAT naming diagnostics via the to_dict method.
TextDeltaComparisonReport class exposes comparable_glyph_count, glyph_count, and moved_glyph_count read-only properties and provides a dictionary representation via the to_dict method.
TextDeltaReport class exposes active_glyph_count, glyph_count, and supported_glyph_count read-only properties and provides a dictionary representation via the to_dict method.

TtfFont class exposes available_naming_strategies, axes, cff_font, color_labels, color_palettes, colr_v1, cvar, and encoding read-only properties; its encoding getter, get_table_bytes, and glyph_accessor getter raise FontParseException conditionally.
TupleScalarDelta class provides a dictionary representation of tuple scalar delta data via the to_dict method.
Type1Font class exposes encoding, font_family, font_name, font_style, font_type, get_kern_pairs, glyph_accessor, and load_afm members.
UnsupportedFontFormatException class represents an exception for unsupported font formats.

VariableAxis class exposes available_languages, css_axis_tag, default_preset, and default_ratio read-only properties and provides clamp, denormalize, describe_value, and css_variation_setting methods.
VariableAxisPreset class provides a to_presentation method.
VariableInstance class exposes available_languages, css_variation_settings, format_coordinates, label, language_profiles, localization_coverage, localization_resolution, and localized_labels members.

WebFontFamilyPackage class provides a write_to method.

AnimationExportPackage class provides a write_to method.
CffCharset class provides from_reader, gid_for, name_for, and standard methods; its from_reader method raises FontParseException conditionally.
CffDict class provides from_bytes, get, set, and to_bytes methods; its from_bytes method raises FontParseException conditionally.
CffEncoding class provides expert, from_reader, get_all_codepoints, standard, and unicode_to_gid methods; its unicode_to_gid method raises GlyphNotFoundException conditionally.
CffIndex class provides from_reader and to_bytes methods; its from_reader method raises FontParseException conditionally.
PrivateDict class provides a from_dict method.
TopDict class provides a from_dict method.
PrivateDictOp class lists the CFF Private Dictionary operators BLUE_VALUES, DEFAULT_WIDTH_X, NOMINAL_WIDTH_X, OTHER_BLUES, STD_HW, STD_VW, and SUBRS.

TopDictOp class lists the CFF Top Dictionary operators CHARSET, CHARSTRINGS, CHARSTRING_TYPE, ENCODING, FAMILY_NAME, FONT_BBOX, FONT_MATRIX, FULL_NAME, IS_FIXED_PITCH, ITALIC_ANGLE, NOTICE, and PRIVATE.

FontConverter class provides the convert method, which raises FontConversionException conditionally.
EotHeader class represents the header of an EOT font file.
CffSerializer class provides the serialize method, which raises FontParseException conditionally.
EotSerializer class provides the serialize method, which raises FontParseException conditionally.
TtfSerializer class provides the serialize method, which raises FontParseException conditionally.
Type1Serializer class provides the serialize_pfa and serialize_pfb methods.
TtfTableSet class provides the get_raw, gvar, and set_raw members.
TtcFaceRecord class represents a face record in a TTC file.
TtfGlyphParser class provides the parse method.

TtfInstancer class provides the available_naming_strategies, instantiate, and preview_naming_policy methods, where instantiate raises FontNotSupportedException and FontParseException conditionally and preview_naming_policy raises FontNotSupportedException conditionally.
AvarTable class provides the from_reader, map_normalized, and map_normalized_by_tag methods, where from_reader raises FontParseException conditionally.
BaseGlyphRecord class represents a base glyph record.
BaseGlyphV1Record class represents a base glyph V1 record.
CmapTable class provides the best_subtable, from_reader, and to_bytes methods, where best_subtable and to_bytes raise FontParseException conditionally.
ColorPalette class represents a color palette.

ColrTable class provides the from_reader and get_glyph_animation methods, where from_reader raises FontParseException conditionally and get_glyph_animation extracts animation sequence for a glyph if animation data is present.
CpalTable class provides the from_reader method.
FeatureVariationRecord class represents a feature variation record.
FeatureVariationTable class provides the find_applicable_records, from_reader, and to_bytes methods, where from_reader raises FontParseException conditionally.

GdefTable class provides the from_reader, get_attachment_points, get_glyph_class, get_ligature_carets, get_mark_attachment_class, and to_bytes methods, where get_attachment_points returns list of attachment point indices for a glyph, get_glyph_class returns glyph class (1=Base, 2=Ligature, 3=Mark, 4=Component, 0=Unassigned), get_ligature_carets returns list of caret coordinates for a ligature glyph, and get_mark_attachment_class returns mark attachment class for a glyph.
GlyfTable class provides the from_reader, get_glyph_bytes, and to_bytes methods.

GposTable class provides the from_reader, get_kern_pairs, get_kerning_pair, get_script, list_all_features, list_features_for_script, list_scripts, and to_bytes methods, where get_kern_pairs extracts kern pairs from GPOS table, get_kerning_pair returns XAdvance delta for specified glyph pair, or 0 if not defined, get_script returns script record for given tag, and list_all_features returns all feature tags defined in the GPOS table.

GsubTable class provides the from_reader, get_ligatures, get_script, get_single_substitutions, list_all_features, list_features_for_script, list_scripts, and to_bytes methods, where get_ligatures returns ligature substitutions for a specific feature, get_script returns script record for given tag, get_single_substitutions returns single substitution mappings for specified feature(s), and list_all_features returns all feature tags defined in the GSUB table.
HMetric class represents a horizontal metric.
HeadTable class provides the from_reader and to_bytes methods.
HheaTable class provides the from_reader and to_bytes methods.
HmtxTable class provides the from_reader, get_metric, and to_bytes methods.

HvarTable class provides the advance_width_delta, compact_for_subset, from_reader, and to_bytes methods, where from_reader raises FontParseException conditionally and compact_for_subset compacts HVAR table for subset font.
LayerRecord class represents a layer record.
LayerV1Record class represents a layer V1 record.
LocaTable class provides the from_reader, glyph_length, glyph_offset, and to_bytes methods.
MaxpTable class provides the from_reader and to_bytes methods.
NameTable class provides the best_name, ensure_english_platform_names, ensure_name_record, from_reader, get, language_key, localized_names, and records_for methods.
Os2Table class provides the from_reader and to_bytes methods.

PaintGlyph class represents a paint glyph structure.
PaintLinearGradient class represents a paint linear gradient structure.

PaintRotate class represents a rotation paint table.
PaintScale class represents a scale paint table.
PaintSkew class represents a skew paint table.
PaintSolid class represents a solid color paint table.
PaintTransform class represents a transform paint table.
PaintTranslate class represents a translation paint table.

AvarAxisMap class represents an axis variation mapping table.
CmapSubtable class provides a get_gid method to map a character code to a glyph identifier.
CoverageTable class represents a coverage table used in GPOS lookups.
FeatureTable class represents a feature table in GPOS.
LangSysTable class represents a language system table in GPOS.
PairAdjustmentRecord class holds a pair adjustment record with an x_advance read-only property that returns the left glyph horizontal advance adjustment in font units.
PairPosFormat1Subtable class represents a pair positioning format 1 subtable.
PairPosFormat2Subtable class represents a pair positioning format 2 subtable.
PairSet class represents a pair set table in GPOS.
ScriptTable class represents a script table in GPOS.
CoverageTable class represents a coverage table used in GSUB lookups.
FeatureTable class represents a feature table in GSUB.
LangSysTable class represents a language system table in GSUB.
Ligature class represents a ligature entry in a ligature set.
LigatureSet class represents a ligature set table in GSUB.
LigatureSubstitutionFormat1 class represents a ligature substitution format 1 subtable that extends SubstitutionSubtable.
ScriptTable class represents a script table in GSUB.
SingleSubstitutionFormat1 class represents a single substitution format 1 subtable that extends SubstitutionSubtable.
SingleSubstitutionFormat2 class represents a single substitution format 2 subtable that extends SubstitutionSubtable.

GvarTable class provides methods to read glyph variation data, including from_reader to parse the table and glyph_variations to retrieve variations, both of which raise FontParseException conditionally.
TupleVariation class represents a tuple variation record.
DeltaSetIndex class represents a delta set index.

DeltaSetIndexMap class provides methods to manage delta set indices, including from_reader to parse the table, get to retrieve an index, compact to re-index for subset glyph mapping, and to_bytes to serialize the table, where from_reader raises FontParseException conditionally.

VariationRegion class provides a scalar method to compute a scalar value for a given variation vector.
VariationRegionAxis class provides a scalar method to compute a scalar value for a given variation vector axis.
NameRecord class represents a name record in the name table.
AfmData class represents data parsed from an AFM file.
AfmGlyphMetric class represents a glyph metric entry in an AFM file.
PfbSegment class represents a segment of a PFB file.
Type1FontData class holds Type 1 font data.
Type1Interpreter class provides the interpret method to process Type 1 font programs.
